title: Red teaming, evaluacija, monitoring i incidenti
summary: AI red teaming i evaluacija kao proces (obim, pravila angažmana, OWASP i ATLAS mapiranje, regresioni testovi u CI-ju), telemetrija AI sistema sa OpenTelemetry gen_ai konvencijama, detekcija zloupotrebe i odgovor na AI incidente sa unaprijed pripremljenim polugama za obuzdavanje.
title_en: Red teaming, evaluation, monitoring and incidents
summary_en: AI red teaming and evaluation as a process (scope, rules of engagement, OWASP and ATLAS mapping, regression tests in CI), AI system telemetry with OpenTelemetry gen_ai conventions, abuse detection and AI incident response with containment levers prepared in advance.
